name: Seeded and deliberately poor test cases for the M7 harness: AML/KYC (Kestrel Wallet, fictional)

change_history.change: First version (M7 step 5): 18 hand-written cases on K01, K06, K11 and K12, 6 of them clean controls, plus 2 story-level seeds. Same format as harness_seeded_cases.json.

notes: Synthetic cases on the fictional Kestrel Wallet stories (datasets/aml_kyc_stories.json v0.3), each with a known defect or known to be clean.
Score with: python -m harness.seeded --set aml (add --no-judge for the free checks only).

Defects mirror the insurance seeds in a second domain: wrong boundary (exactly on a 'more than' limit), invented rule, over-claim, not atomic, vague values, wrong arithmetic on indirect ownership, missing expected result, unknown AC, reworded duplicate, generic title with placeholders.

Submission date 24/11/2026.
test_cases.expected_result: The application continues; it is not refused with reason code UNDERAGE.

cases.defect: control: exactly 18 on the submission date continues (AC2 boundary, correct)
incorrect: exactly 18 asserted as UNDERAGE (contradicts AC2)
not in basis: invents a 12-month lock-out
over-claim: lists AC4 but the date of birth is neither in the future nor 121+
incorrect: score 70 asserted as MEDIUM (AC2: 70 is HIGH)
not atomic: bands, cap and EDD in one case
vague: 'a high risk score' and 'handled correctly'
control: indirect 50% x 60% = 30% is a beneficial owner (AC4 worked example)
incorrect: 40% x 60% = 24% is not over 25%, asserted as a beneficial owner
links to an AC the story does not have (AC9)
incorrect: exactly 5,000.00 asserted as LARGE_TXN ('more than')
control: three deposits in band within 24 hours raise STRUCTURING (AC3)

story_level.defect: K12 seeds test AC2 and AC3 only: AC5 (high-risk country) has no test linked
K06: the 0 and 100 ends of the score range (AC1) are never tested
